fields.Name: R1 -> S7.3
fields.Description: Gate G5.1 (owner PR 4, phase 5, dataset R1, criterion S7.3): scoring the R1 model on a copy table with DistanceZ renamed is refused with an error naming the scope entity and writes 0 rows, 1 of 1 (FM-15; today the value is read from the training table). The check fills pstruth.Scn_R1Copy with R1's rows (DistanceZ renamed DistanceZRenamed), creates a test scoring binding of the published R1 unit model on the copy entity and scores 25 of its records through Score Record Set: check 3 must refuse scope-entity-mismatch naming the copy entity before any row is read, with the run row stored refused, Written 0, and no Feature Value for the binding. No scope ever maps onto another entity (the Score Record Set entityMapping input is removed), so a copy's keys are never scored from the training table.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: The R1 model on the renamed copy is refused scope-entity-mismatch naming the copy entity, 0 rows written, 1 of 1.
